Class MudInstance

java.lang.Object
io.github.protasm.jvmud.instance.MudInstance
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class MudInstance extends Object implements InstanceHost
Runtime and serialized world operations for one independently hosted mudlib.

      public static MudInstance boot(Path mudlibRoot, String configObjectPath, MudlibBootProgress progress)
      Boots a persistent mud instance and reports host-visible progress to the supplied callback.
      Parameters:
      mudlibRoot - filesystem root of the selected mudlib
      configObjectPath - mudlib-relative JVMud configuration path
      progress - callback for local startup progress events
      Returns:
      booted mud instance ready for session attachment

    • boot

      public static MudInstance boot(Path mudlibRoot, String configObjectPath, MudlibBootProgress progress, LPCObjectLoadObserver objectLoadObserver)
      Boots a persistent mud instance with host-visible preload and object-load diagnostics.
      Parameters:
      mudlibRoot - filesystem root of the selected mudlib
      configObjectPath - mudlib-relative JVMud configuration path
      progress - callback for local startup progress events
      objectLoadObserver - observer for each shared LPC object load attempt
      Returns:
      booted mud instance ready for session attachment

    • reloadMudlibObject

      public LPCObjectHandle reloadMudlibObject(String objectPath)
      Recompiles and replaces one shared mudlib object while this instance remains online.

      The path is an LPC object id relative to the selected mudlib's active source root, such as system/quests. Existing callers resolve the replacement through the same stable object id. Host administration code should use this operation only for shared service or content objects whose own reload policy is safe; it is intentionally not exposed as an unauthenticated player transport command.

      Parameters:
      objectPath - mudlib-relative LPC object id, with or without a .c suffix
      Returns:
      handle for the newly compiled shared object
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the path is blank or escapes the active mudlib root
